title: South Valley Cement records a net profit for the first half of 2026
summary: South Valley Cement records a net profit for the first half of 2026
body_markdown: **Egypt:** According to Arab Finance, South Valley Cement has reported a net profit of US$2.5m in the first six months of 2026, compared to a net loss of US$1.9m in the corresponding period of 2025. Cement sales reached US$26.1m by the end of June 2026, up from US$23.6m in the same period of 2025.
